meta.description: Add strict Nature/CNS citations to manuscript text by splitting long passages into citable segments, searching only accepted flagship and subjournal titles from Nature Portfolio, the AAAS Science family, and Cell Press, filtering by publication time range, and exporting one reference-manager-ready output by default. Supports bilingual operation (Chinese/English) with citation file management.

scientific_integrity.detail: Conservative support grading prevents inappropriate citations. Metadata-only candidates require abstract verification. Author-integrity gate ensures complete structured metadata.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for literature citation in academic writing. Strict journal filtering (Nature/CNS) aligns with high-impact publication requirements.

methodological_ground.detail: Evidence grading system (strong/partial/background/contradictory) follows established citation practices. Claim parsing methodology is sound.

code_usability.detail: Working script (nature_citation.py) with clear flags and batch strategy. Includes HTML visualization for review.

functional_suitability.note: Complete citation workflow: text segmentation, claim parsing, search, conservative support evaluation, author-integrity validation, and reference-manager export (RIS/ENW/RDF). HTML browser for manual curation.

reliability.note: Robust quality gates: author-integrity check prevents incomplete metadata export. Conservative support grading avoids inappropriate citations. Batch strategy for long articles prevents context overflow.

performance_context.note: Efficient segmentation strategy. Batch mode for long articles (>10 segments). Static/dynamic split keeps normal runs lean. Rate-limit awareness for polite API usage.

agent_usability.note: Excellent router design with clear 4-step protocol. Manifest-driven always_load specification. Runtime parameter detection (scope, language, length) handled inline without fragment proliferation.

human_usability.note: Strong bilingual support (Chinese/English). HTML visualization browser for review. Clear report format with browser path first. Multi-format export (RIS/ENW/RDF). Comprehensive trigger phrases in both languages.

security.note: API usage includes tool/email parameters for polite pool. No credential hardcoding. Author-integrity gate prevents data fabrication. Conservative citation prevents misleading support claims.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design. Core principles, Chinese mode, and workflow separated. On-demand references for deep material. Versioned manifest (v2.1.0). Easy to extend journal scope or add export formats.

agent_specific.note: Strong parameterized workflow design. Inline scope/language detection efficient. Clear 7-step workflow. Minor: lacks explicit fallback when nature_citation.py unavailable (no MCP alternative documented).

key_strengths: Exceptional quality control: author-integrity gate prevents incomplete metadata export, conservative support grading avoids inappropriate citations
Excellent bilingual support (Chinese/English) with language-specific operating modes and comprehensive trigger phrase coverage
Robust scalability: batch processing strategy for long articles prevents context overflow while maintaining unified output
Strong user experience: HTML visualization browser for manual curation, clear report format with interactive path first
Clean modular architecture: static/dynamic split with parameterized runtime variation instead of content axis proliferation

recommendations.title: Document fallback when nature_citation.py unavailable
recommendations.problem: Skill strongly prefers scripts/nature_citation.py but lacks documented fallback when script is unavailable (missing dependencies, no internet access, different runtime environment).
recommendations.root_cause: No MCP-based alternative documented like nature-academic-search has. References mention PubMed E-utilities as comparison but not as replacement workflow.
recommendations.fix: Add fallback workflow using MCP tools (search_papers with journal filters, pubmed_format_citations for export). Document in references/script-usage.md as 'No-script fallback' section.

recommendations.title: Add cross-format consistency validation
recommendations.problem: When exporting multiple formats (RIS/ENW/RDF), format-specific field mappings differ (e.g., RIS 'TY' vs ENW '%0', RDF predicates) but no validation confirms citation consistency across formats.
recommendations.root_cause: Each format generated independently without cross-check. references/ris-endnote.md describes formats but not validation logic.
recommendations.fix: Add post-export validation step: compare essential fields (authors, title, DOI, year) across all generated formats. Report any discrepancies before finalizing.

recommendations.title: Enhance gap reporting with CNS coverage context
recommendations.problem: When no CNS literature exists for a claim, skill reports gap plainly but doesn't explain whether the topic is outside CNS journal scope, too recent, or requires broader search.
recommendations.root_cause: Gap detection is binary (found/not found) without categorizing why the gap exists.
recommendations.fix: Add gap classification: (1) topic not covered by CNS journals, (2) too recent (suggest broader date range), (3) niche methodology (suggest related terms), (4) contradictory evidence (flag conflict). Include in report under '风险和缺口' section.
